title: Emergent Inference-Time Semantic Contamination via In-Context Priming
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM behavior and 'emergent misalignment' by categorizing model outputs into semantic groups, including a 'Spiritual' category and 'Dark' categories (e.g., Nazi, Authoritarian). It specifically uses priming numbers with spiritual and religious significance (e.g., 108 for Hinduism/Buddhism/Jainism) and evaluates the resulting shift in the model's expressed values.
